svg.aria-label: Context per API call over one session, stacked by cache read, cache creation and fresh input, with prompt markers, a compaction, findings and subagent lanes
svg.text: Each step is one model call; height is the context it sent. Hover a step for its breakdown and the prompt it served.
Prompts are vertical rules; findings are pinned where their triggering events occur. Subagents run in their own context, so their calls appear in their own lane.
